tools.name: search_trains
tools.description: Search Indian Railways trains by name, number, or text. Upstream limit: 60 requests/minute; results may be cached for up to 12 hours.

query.description: Train name, number, or search text.

tools.name: get_train_info
tools.description: Get a train's identity, endpoints, and available running instances. Upstream limit: 30 requests/minute; results may be cached for up to 30 minutes.

tools.name: get_train_schedule
tools.description: Get a train's scheduled stops, running days, times, and available station coordinates. Upstream limit: 20 requests/minute; results may be cached for up to 12 hours.

date.description: Optional service start date in DD-MMM-YYYY format, for example "26-Jul-2026".

tools.name: get_train_live_status
tools.description: Get live station-by-station progress, delays, platforms, current reported position, and route geometry. Upstream limit: 12 requests/minute; live results may be cached for up to 45 seconds.

date.description: Optional service start date in DD-MMM-YYYY format, for example "26-Jul-2026".

tools.name: find_trains_between_stations
tools.description: Find direct trains between two station codes, optionally sorted by fastest journey or earliest departure. Upstream limit: 20 requests/minute; results may be cached for up to 30 minutes.

from.description: Indian Railways station code, for example "HWH" or "NDLS".

to.description: Indian Railways station code, for example "HWH" or "NDLS".

tools.name: get_train_exceptions
tools.description: Get exceptional service information such as cancellations or diversions. Read the returned message field. Upstream limit: 20 requests/minute; results may be cached for up to 5 minutes.

tools.name: get_pnr_status
tools.description: Look up Indian Railways PNR booking, passenger, and chart status. PNR data is sensitive. Upstream limit: 2 requests/minute; PNR results are never stored in the result cache.

tools.name: get_station_coordinates
tools.description: Get the name and bundled map coordinates for an Indian Railways station code. Upstream limit: 120 requests/minute.

code.description: Indian Railways station code, for example "HWH" or "NDLS".

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search bundled Indian Railways stations by code or name. Upstream limit: 120 requests/minute.

tools.name: track_trains
tools.description: Get live tracking for up to 10 trains in one request. Individual train failures are returned in the trains array. Upstream limit: 6 requests/minute; successful live results may be cached for up to 45 seconds.

train_numbers.description: One to ten unique train numbers.

tools.name: check_traintrack_health
tools.description: Check whether the public TrainTrack API is available. Upstream limit: 120 requests/minute.
